title: Densify native H3 time by visual-token inpainting
summary: Map an existing H3 visual-token stream to a longer 24 fps model-time lattice, preserve source tokens as anchors, let the same H3 model inpaint missing token intervals bidirectionally, crop legal-lattice padding, and deliver at a multiplied frame rate without using an interpolation model.

graph_contract.role: validate the source packed H3 AV state
construct the longer H3 token lattice, copy source anchors, and attach continuous native video/audio denoise masks
rebuild official H3 conditioning at the target temporal and spatial geometry
sample the missing visual tokens with the source tokens available on both temporal sides
remove consumed mask metadata while preserving generated native state
crop only the legal-lattice tail padding from decoded frames

evidence.summary: Token placement, native AV shapes, continuous masks, exact delivery count, legal H3 padding, and output clock are unit-validated; live H3 visual characterization remains required.
